label: Bible Study
prompt: _____ me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:
verse: Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:
note: David closes his psalm on God's all-knowing presence by inviting the search.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: _____ is he that calleth you, who also will do it.
verse: Faithful is he that calleth you, who also will do it.
note: Whatever God calls you to, He also does — faithful is He that calleth.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And she went, and came, and gleaned in the field after the reapers: and her _____ was to light on a part of the field belonging unto Boaz, who was of the kindred of Elimelech.
verse: And she went, and came, and gleaned in the field after the reapers: and her hap was to light on a part of the field belonging unto Boaz, who was of the kindred of Elimelech.
note: 'Her hap was' — her luck was — to glean in a field belonging to Boaz; the book's quiet way of saying God arranged it.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the ways of David his father, and _____ neither to the right hand, nor to the left.
verse: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the ways of David his father, and declined neither to the right hand, nor to the left.
note: Josiah became king at eight and never veered — right or left — from David's path.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Holding faith, and a good conscience; which some having put away concerning faith have made _____:
verse: Holding faith, and a good conscience; which some having put away concerning faith have made shipwreck:
note: Some 'made shipwreck' of their faith — and Paul, who'd been shipwrecked three times (2 Corinthians 11:25), knew the image.
